BankSystemState.description: Central real-time banking state synchronized across all client devices and admin dashboards.

user.description: Active user profile information including balances and contact details.

accounts.description: List of client bank accounts and current balances.

transactions.description: Chronological ledger of cleared, pending, and reviewed transactions.

cards.description: Debit and credit payment cards, limits, and security status.

payees.description: Saved payees and bill payment recipients.

pendingChanges.description: Queue of profile and card limit changes submitted for admin review.

supportMessages.description: Direct message thread between client and Tompkins operations desk.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent database mutation.

/banking_system/{systemId}.description: Global synchronized banking system state shared across all mobile and desktop devices.
